name: avatar-22
description: A dropdown workspace switcher where each option leads with a square avatar.

files.content: import { ChevronsUpDown as ChevronsUpDownIcon, Plus as PlusIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dropdown-menu" const workspaces = [ { name: "Designali Studio", plan: "Pro", short: "DS" }, { name: "Designali Clients", plan: "Team", short: "DC" }, { name: "Dalim Works", plan: "Free", short: "DW" }, ] export default function WorkspaceSwitcherMenu() { return ( } > DS Designali Studio Workspaces {workspaces.map((workspace) => ( {workspace.short} {workspace.name} {workspace.plan} ))} Create workspace ) }
